description: Hi! I’m a Computer Science (AI & ML) student with strong skills in C, Java, and algorithmic problem-solving. I’m passionate about building reliable, real-time software for space exploration. Join CodeX to build an innovative health monitoring system for astronauts—we focus on clean execution, practical architecture, and rapid prototyping. Looking for teammates skilled in UI/UX design, data visualization, web/app development, or biomedical/human factors to bring this project to life!
